mentions.name: Colma
mentions.description: This tool takes any website, does deep research on who is searching and what the site's offers are, and then produces a plan and recommendations to increase the site's visibility on Google, ChatGPT, and other search surfaces. It is a solo venture built alongside the author's dad, a 30-year digital marketing veteran with a small agency, and is currently in pilot stage with a few agencies and website builders.
mentions.problem: Generic LLM advice for improving website visibility is bad, and website owners who want more visibility on Google and ChatGPT lack good guidance on what to do.
mentions.audience: Website owners (businesses) seeking more visibility on Google and ChatGPT, currently piloting with agencies and website builders
mentions.source_excerpt:
[Colma](https://www.colma.ai/) solo venture, working with my dad who has been in digital marketing for 30 years and has a small agency.
